Сертифікації

Machine Learning and Web3 Engineering

Досвід роботи

Senior Data Engineer with 4+ years architecting lakehouse and real-time data platforms across fintech and telecom, specializing in CDC-based streaming ingestion, medallion data modeling, and dbt-driven data quality and governance frameworks.

Досягнення

• Lakehouse Architecture & Latency Cut (Fintech):
Architected the migration of a multi-bank data ecosystem (6 partner banks, 10GB+ daily) from unmanaged S3 Parquet to a governed Apache Iceberg/Trino lakehouse with Medallion architecture. Reduced query latency by 65% and established the platform’s first audit-grade data governance standard.

• Real-Time CDC Streaming (Fintech):
Replaced legacy full-table batch ingestion with a streaming OLake CDC pipeline into a Trino-managed Iceberg bronze layer, cutting daily data movement by 90% and slashing ingestion latency from 5 hours to under 30 minutes.

• Telecom-Scale Warehouse (15M+ Users):
Engineered and maintained the customer lifecycle data warehouse for 15M+ active subscribers at Safaricom, sustaining 99.9%+ data availability across 6 downstream analytics and marketing teams. Redesigned core lake-to-warehouse ETL pipelines, reducing batch runtimes from 8 hours to 2 hours (75% drop) and failed jobs from 20% to 5%.

• Data Observability & Incident Reduction:
Built an automated data observability framework (freshness monitoring dashboards + real-time alerting) that reduced mean time-to-detect (MTTD) for pipeline failures from 12 hours to under 15 minutes, cutting business-reported data incidents by 90%.

• Data Contracts & Quality Assurance (Retail/GCP):
Implemented 8 dbt models with 15 automated data-quality assertions in BigQuery at Mattress Firm, catching \~85% of data anomalies pre-production and establishing the team’s first formal data contract for downstream reporting.

• Location Hierarchy Normalization Engine:
Engineered an automated geo-standardization engine reconciling 1.5M+ fragmented user records into official government regional hierarchies, lifting downstream reporting accuracy from 40% to 97%.

Очікування від роботи

• Role: Senior Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer / Analytics Engineer
• Work Format: Fully remote (Contract / B2B or Full-Time)
• Team & Culture: Engineering-led teams with high ownership, clear communication, modern engineering standards (CI/CD, code review, automated testing), and an appreciation for data correctness.
• Preferred Tech Ecosystem: Modern Data Stack (Iceberg, Trino, dbt, Spark, Airflow/Dagster), cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse), and event-driven/CDC architectures (Kafka, Debezium, streaming ingestion).
• Domain Interests: Fintech, Cloud & SaaS Intelligence, High-throughput Analytics, Big Data, and AI/ML-enabling data platforms.
